header: Fetching a paper's metadata from the archive
code:
# Every published paper is reachable by its DOI
curl -s https://api.northstarlabs.example/v2/papers/10.48711/nsq.2026.0142 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $LODESTAR_TOKEN" \
  | jq '.title, .issue, .licence, .open_access_from'
